messages:
Jess Morales: noticing a 502 spike hitting guest-facing hosted API since ~09:12 UTC. saw a sawtooth pattern every ~20s, customers report failed embed requests. attaching quick notes below. :eyes:
SRE-Bot: ALERT: prod-edge gw 502-rate increase (eu1) - 09:13 UTC - spike detected on frontdoor pool. 5xx rate: 8% -> 24% over 5m.
Support Ops: customer #C-98321 opened a P1 — intermittent failures for batch-embeds, reports about retries not helping. SLA escalation requested.
Lia Chen: any signs of auth failures or backlog on auth-cache? or is this purely downstream egress failures?
Jess Morales: initial traces show upstream resets from envoy: `RST_STREAM` and occasional `HTTP/2 STREAM_CLOSED` logged. no auth 401s. headers look normal.
Pravin Rao: can you share a curl that reproduces? also need a sample trace id for correlated logs.
Jess Morales: quick repro I used (from eu1):
```
curl -vv -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"input": "embed me", "model": "embed-small", "batch": true}' \
  https://api.redwood-inference.prod/embed
```
response sometimes: `HTTP/2 502` with no body, sometimes `upstream reset`. trace id: `t-eu1-7f9d2a` (attached).
Marco Silva: pasted relevant envoy excerpt: 
```
[2025-11-09T09:13:22Z] envoy error: upstream reset: error_code=STREAM_RESET, reason=ENHANCE_YOUR_CALM
[2025-11-09T09:13:42Z] h2 keepalive: connection window exhausted, inflight streams=128, queued=430
```
Lia Chen: sounds like h2 conn window / stream slot starvation when fanout hits many upstreams. embedders do small requests but high concurrency. likely conn-pool exhaustion + long-lived KV cache warms causing bursts.
Pravin Rao: check kube-hosted sidecars for envoy restart patterns? also confirm auth-proxy threads not pegged — those cause head-of-line issues.
Jess Morales: no envoy restarts, but midproxy logs show steady increase in active streams and long tail write stalls.
Support Ops: customer timeline: failures began at 09:12, hit peak 09:17, partial recovery ~09:25 after retries. impact: ~40% of requests failing for that tenant during peak window.
SRE-Bot: Added runbook link: https://intra/runbooks/edge-h2-stream-saturation.
Lia Chen: mitigation idea: temporarily reduce max concurrent streams per connection on frontdoor to force more connections (reduces single-conn queueing). also enable fallback-routing to dedicated pool for heavy tenants.
Pravin Rao: quick workaround we can push: lower `envoy.http2.max_concurrent_streams` on the edge pool to 32 and bump upstream connect pool to 8. need a short deploy, low-risk.
Marco Silva: I can prepare the changelist. will also add a metric alert for `envoy_h2_streams_queued` > 200.
Jess Morales: reproduction steps recorded for support playbook:
- run the curl above in a tight loop (concurrency 60)
- watch for `HTTP/2 502` or `RST_STREAM`
- capture `trace id` from response header (x-redwood-trace) and attach logs from edge and midproxy

Example repro command we used:
```
seq 1 120 | xargs -n1 -P60 -I{} curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}\n" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"input":"ping","model":"embed-small"}' https://api.redwood-inference.prod/embed
```

Support Ops: I've informed the customer of temporary mitigation + ETA. ticket updated.
Pravin Rao: Marco, go ahead with the config tweak on canary edge pool first. set rollback window of 10m and watch `5xx_rate` and `envoy_h2_streams_queued`.
Marco Silva: deploying patch to canary now. will post status.
(10m later) Marco Silva: canary shows 70% drop in queued streams and 502 rate down to baseline. rolling to rest of edge.
Jess Morales: confirmed customer reports improved success rate after roll. closing P1 once full roll completes and we monitor 1h.
Lia Chen: follow-up actions:
- add long-term fix: smarter fanout backpressure and per-tenant concurrency limit in frontdoor router
- add targeted test in chaos lab for high-concurrency batch-embed pattern
- update runbook with repro steps and `x-redwood-trace` capture notes
Support Ops: noted, will add to post-incident summary and customer write-up. :white_check_mark:
